findings.title: PraisonAI 16-CVE Second-Batch — Hardcoded JWT Key, Sandbox Escape, Default-No-Auth Across Core + Platform
findings.affected_technology: PraisonAI (core, pip) and praisonai-platform (enterprise SaaS layer, pip)
findings.summary: GitHub Advisories published a 16-CVE coordinated batch against PraisonAI core + platform on 2026-05-28/29 covering hardcoded JWT signing key 'dev-secret-change-me' enabling token forgery, cross-workspace IDOR + privilege escalation to owner, unauthenticated LLM-driven code execution, Python builtins sandbox escape, and Flask API shipping with authentication disabled by default — second multi-CVE batch against PraisonAI in 45 days.

findings.title: Marimo CVE-2026-39987 UPDATE — Sysdig Confirms In-Wild LLM-Agent Post-Compromise (Cloud-Cred → AWS Secrets Manager → Parallel SSH → DB Exfil in 2 Minutes)
findings.summary: Sysdig published the first publicly documented end-to-end LLM-agent post-exploitation chain against a real victim — Marimo WebSocket RCE initial access pivoted via AWS instance metadata to Secrets Manager SSH key retrieval and eight parallel SSH sessions, with full PostgreSQL schema discovery and content exfiltration completed in under two minutes; Chinese-language planning comment 看还能做什么 and machine-optimised command formatting fingerprint the LLM-agent operator.

findings.title: ChatGPhish — Markdown-Image Rendering in ChatGPT Web Summaries Enables Stealth Phishing + IP/UA/Referer Leakage
findings.affected_technology: OpenAI ChatGPT web client response renderer (chatgpt.com)
findings.summary: Permiso Security disclosed a class of ChatGPT response-rendering issues where malicious Markdown images and links in webpages summarised by ChatGPT render inside the trusted chatgpt.com interface, leaking the user's IP/User-Agent/Referer to attacker servers via image fetches and serving phishing payloads (fake security alerts, QR codes) that bypass email and desktop URL filters.

findings.title: LLMShare Campaign — chatgpt.com/s/ Share-Pages Abused for Fake-Outage Malware Delivery via Google Ads
findings.summary: Push Security tracked an active campaign abusing ChatGPT's shared-conversation feature to host attacker-controlled HTML on the trusted chatgpt.com origin, displaying fake 'ChatGPT outage' notices and redirecting users to openew[.]app which serves Windows + macOS malware-laden fake desktop clients; Google Ads on ChatGPT search queries drive the funnel.

findings.title: Asocks 17M-Device Residential-Proxy Botnet Takedown — 200+ Servers Seized in Netherlands
findings.summary: Dutch NCSC + National Police seized 200+ servers at a Netherlands-based hosting provider supporting the Asocks 'universal proxy service' covert residential-proxy botnet of ~17M infected endpoints, contradicting Asocks' voluntary-bandwidth marketing — fourth major adversary-infrastructure disruption in 14 days alongside Fox Tempest, GlassWorm v2, and Stark Industries/MIRhosting.

findings.title: Vibe-Coded Apps — Red Access 'Shadow Builders' Finds 2,000+ Sensitive-Data Exposures Across AI-No-Code Platforms
findings.affected_technology: AI vibe-coding / no-code platforms (Cursor, v0/Vercel, Bolt, Lovable, Replit Ghostwriter et al.)
findings.summary: Red Access's 'Shadow Builders' report catalogued ~380,000 publicly accessible vibe-platform assets with 2,000+ holding sensitive corporate/operational/personal data — many granting admin access by default to anyone reaching the URL while connecting directly to production CRMs/ERPs/BI systems, bypassing DLP/CASB/SSO; positioned as a distinct Shadow AI asset class.

noted.product: Apache Solr BasicAuth via bin/solr CLI
noted.summary: Enabling BasicAuth through the bin/solr CLI silently configures additional users with insecure defaults (oss-security 2026-05-29); audit security.json on Solr clusters where BasicAuth was CLI-enabled.
PROXY-protocol uninitialised-stack disclosure leaks adjacent memory to peer (oss-security 2026-05-29); bounded impact but worth tracking for memory-disclosure-to-bypass chains.

noted.product: EDK II firmware partition-table TPM measurement
noted.summary: Partition-table TPM measurement-list issues in EDK II firmware (oss-security 2026-05-29); firmware-tier integrity edge case affecting attestation/measured-boot.
Arbitrary code execution via Python omni-completion in older Vim builds (oss-security 2026-05-29); local client/dev-tool only, OOS for infra scope but worth flagging for dev workstations.
Solar Designer reported a race in netif_rxq_cleanup_unlease() ordering inversion (oss-security 2026-05-29); kernel net-stack DMA window, track for downstream patches.

LinkedIn-recruiter social engineering against crypto firms + developers deploying AUDIOFIX (Python) + MiniRAT (Go) via fake meeting clients and compromised @velora-dex/sdk npm; TTPs mirror BlueNoroff/Contagious Interview without infrastructure overlap.

DPRK-aligned Kimsuky distributing HTTPSpy RAT disguised as Korean security-software installers (nProtect, AhnLab) and fake Cisco Webex camera-fix prompts targeting South Korean military/corporate; social engineering, no new CVE.

Brazilian-banking SDK supply-chain compromise exfiltrating PFX certs + passwords + client IDs to hardcoded Sentry endpoint, ~500 downloads + 11 sibling 'sicoob' packages totalling ~6,000 downloads; NuGet has removed.
Federation peer registration lacks explicit out-of-band approval and cleartext non-loopback transport permitted; niche but flags self-hosted federation governance gaps.
Consumer/PII breach with identity-theft risk; intrusion vector pending — consumer-PII class, OOS for infra-CVE focus.

HIBP confirmed 4.9M accounts + 85K employee-directory subset (BleepingComputer 2026-05-29) extending the 2026-05-29 noted entry; ShinyHunters initial-access via April 2026 vishing-to-Entra/Salesforce chain unchanged.
151 CVEs (22 critical + 123 high) patched 2026-05-29; use-after-free + insufficient-validation dominant — client browser, OOS for infra scope but flagged for fleet-patch ack.
Device-Bound Session Credentials cryptographically tie cookies to TPM/Secure-Enclave keys mitigating infostealer cookie-theft → MFA-bypass; mandatory for Workspace tenants — defensive feature note.

~10× growth in service ads (38→364), ~4× unique clusters (31→123), ~3× active actors (15→41); subscription pricing from $25/month up to $2,000 for premium botnets — background telemetry, no specific advisory.
